jobs.title: Veil adept
jobs.alignment: Unassigned; could suit Dominion or another covert tradition
jobs.boundary: Concealment through shadow; magic with no special device.
jobs.notes: A sorcerer folds shadow over part of herself. Tests an eerie, restrained spell expressed through darkness and disappearing form, with no equipment explaining it.
jobs.brief:
A NEW adult human woman about 34, notably beautiful but distinctive: olive skin, long slightly hooked nose, dark eyes, short wavy black hair and a strong asymmetric mouth. Full body, three-quarter view stepping quietly LEFT. Practical close-cut dark plum wool coat over a charcoal linen tunic, narrow trousers and soft worn boots; one plain belt, small utility knife sheathed, no corset, armor gauntlet, ornate staff, jewelry source or glamour pose.
Her ordinary floor shadow has risen into ONE broad velvety charcoal-black volume around her lower left side and shoulder. Parts of the coat and one forearm dissolve into it; the face and the other hand remain clearly visible. One small purposeful inward hand gesture suggests she is drawing concealment around herself. The phenomenon is opaque shadow with soft edges and a faint cool violet undertone, NOT strips of fabric, smoke tentacles, ribbons, a glowing aura or dozens of wisps. Her anatomy remains intact behind the partial concealment. The effect should feel unsettling and quietly powerful.
Two supporting studies: (1) the same head and upper shoulders completely unshrouded for face clarity; (2) a close study of ordinary coat folds passing into featureless shadow and becoming hard to see. No scenery, enemies, portals, summoned companion or additional body. Concealment is the proposed effect; no invisibility mechanics or fixed faction uniform are implied.

jobs.title: Rime drake
jobs.boundary: A creature's magic can be part of its presence and behavior.
jobs.notes: A drake exhales a dense freezing breath. Tests creature magic and a cold visual language—condensation, rime and pale crystal—without apparatus or energy cords.
jobs.brief:
Input image references the established drake's believable winged reptilian anatomy and painted material quality ONLY. Create a new cold-breath individual/proposed variation, not a settled new species. Do not copy the orange palette, aerial pose or sky.
A lean horse-sized drake at rest in three-quarter view facing RIGHT: four coherent legs and exactly two batlike wings partly folded close to the back, full tail visible, light bone-grey hide with broad muted slate patches, short swept horns and an irregular low crest. The neck is thicker at the throat than the reference and the skull has a broad wedge profile; avoid merely repainting the original. Natural alert animal expression, not a pet smile, face mask, rider mount or monster with exaggerated teeth.
It exhales ONE short dense cloud of cold white condensation close to the mouth. Fine frost collects on its lower jaw, throat scales and the small patch of ground directly ahead; a few tiny pale ice crystals catch light. The breath has real volume and softness, no laser beam, blue energy tendrils, enormous storm, glowing runes or magical harness. Keep the majority of the body's silhouette clear.
Two supporting studies: (1) close head and throat with mouth slightly open, cold vapor and readable natural jaw; (2) an ordinary folded wing joint and shoulder, showing coherent anatomy and frosted membrane edge. No saddle, armor, handler, device, environment or implied domestication. Anatomical and magical variation are exploratory.

jobs.title: Banked flame blade
jobs.boundary: An item holds magical energy for its user to harness.
jobs.notes: A plain fighting blade carries banked heat within the steel. Tests enchantment as a property of an item, with the bearer using it naturally and no added casting mechanism.
jobs.brief:
A NEW adult human man around 48, broad chest, tan skin, receding dark hair, close salt-and-pepper beard, broken nose and a wry alert ordinary face. Full body, relaxed but competent stance facing slightly right, dressed in a maintained short mail shirt over dark rust wool, plain brown trousers and practical boots. One leather belt with a normal scabbard. No apparatus, bracer, lantern backpack or faction-standard matching kit.
He holds a modest single-edged falchion angled down and away, examining the blade rather than attacking. The weapon is well-forged dark steel with a simple iron guard and leather grip. A narrow band just inside the cutting edge has the warm orange-white incandescence of BANKED HEAT IN METAL; tiny sparks occasionally leave the edge and the nearby air shimmers. The rest of the blade remains solid cool grey steel. No fiery sword-shaped energy projection, flame ribbons, huge burning plume, rune writing, crystal battery or caster pouring power into it. His other hand is relaxed and does not cast.
Two supporting studies: (1) the full blade alone while quiescent, its embedded warmth almost dark and its simple craftsmanship clear; (2) the same blade's edge close-up with banked heat awakened, light visibly IN the metal and a few discrete sparks. The magic is an intrinsic enchantment held by a useful weapon. No instructions explaining how it must be activated or which faction owns the technique.

jobs.title: Rain gathering
jobs.alignment: Unassigned; religious, natural or scholarly readings remain open
jobs.boundary: Ritual can affect the world without a mechanism or fixed visible energy connection.
jobs.notes: Three people gather a brief, localized rain. Tests communal magic through a natural event, while leaving its source and ritual rules open.
jobs.brief:
A small ritual by THREE adult humans from one local community, ordinary worn clothing in dull indigo, brown and undyed linen. No ceremonial uniform, elaborate regalia, wands, staffs, goggles, glowing jewelry or machinery. The central woman is about 55 with a broad weathered face and tied grey hair; a younger man kneels and an adult woman stands a little behind. All are absorbed and composed, with different natural gestures: the older woman holds out one palm to feel the rain, the kneeling person attends an ordinary shallow stone basin, the third watches the small cloud. Do not make all three perform identical superhero hand poses.
A compact low grey rain cloud roughly three metres across hangs above them against the pale neutral backdrop. A SHORT localized shower falls in discrete droplets into and around the basin. Clear ripples, damp sleeves and tiny beads of water show what the magic does. The cloud has ordinary atmospheric blue-grey weight, not purple smoke or a glowing spell orb. The surrounding paper stays blank and dry outside this little study. No streams of energy joining hands, bodies, basin or cloud. The basin catches water; it is not visibly a magical engine or power source.
Two supporting studies: (1) a close palm with actual raindrops and damp linen, quiet wonder; (2) water dimpling the plain basin with a modest reflection of the cloud. No map, landscape, flood, village or agriculture. This tests a brief local ritual, not routine weather control or unlimited water production.

jobs.title: Enchanter's quench
jobs.alignment: Unassigned; especially relevant to scholarly craft
jobs.boundary: One way magic may enter manufacture, without defining all industry.
jobs.notes: A maker finishes an enchanted blade in an ordinary workshop. Tests a selective meeting of craft and magic; the enchantment's source stays unexplained.
jobs.brief:
A compact useful forge-work study: one experienced human smith about 58 with a broad freckled face, rough greying beard, rolled pale linen sleeves and a plain dark apron. He lowers a forged straight blade halfway into a long ordinary stone quench trough using simple iron tongs, a focused absorbed posture. The entire torso, feet, trough and a modest adjacent workbench fit comfortably in the main view. A pair of plain hammers, finishing stone and one completed blade are enough tools; no crowded workshop scenery, glowing machinery, writing, giant gears, optical devices or apparatus on the smith.
The blade's cool steel briefly reveals a deep internal sapphire iridescence like light under water as it enters the quench. The effect stays WITHIN the metal; its reflected light colors the nearby water and tongs. Normal white steam rises locally and quietly. The man's hands do not emit a power beam. No luminous water threads, purple ropes, bottled spell fuel, visible magic source, rune circuitry or scroll-fed process. He is finishing an enchanted item; the picture need not explain where its magic originated. The rest of the workshop remains ordinary and practical.
Two supporting studies: (1) a completed plain straight sword on a folded cloth, with the same subtle impossible depth in its steel; (2) a close view of tongs, part of the blade and the waterline showing the fleeting internal light. Painted steel and human craft should be beautiful. This is selective specialist manufacture, not a mass-production system or a rule that all metalwork is magical.

jobs.title: Stoneward colossus
jobs.alignment: Unassigned; its makers and allegiance remain open
jobs.boundary: A large construct can feel magical without exposing its power source.
jobs.notes: A monumental stone-and-bronze guardian has weight and presence but no displayed engine or glowing core. Tests a more mysterious large construct alongside the mechanical crane.
jobs.brief:
A NEW five-metre-tall MADE guardian of pale weathered stone and a few broad dark-bronze structural bands. It is a construct, not a living species, stone-skinned giant or human knight in armor. Invent a powerful asymmetrical sculptural silhouette: a wide hollow chest shaped like an incomplete arch, two thick load-bearing stone legs with broad feet, a short off-centre faceless stone head, and two broad slab-like forearms that can bar passage. One shoulder is higher and one arm slightly longer, with clear purposeful architecture rather than random ruin pieces. The negative space in the chest is empty and dark, NOT a glowing heart, gemstone, soul cage, furnace or doorway portal.
The guardian takes one slow small step and lowers one broad arm across its front, an unmistakably animated but weight-bearing pose. Human scale is established by ONE ordinary 1.7-metre adult standing at a respectful distance near its foot. The human is observing, not visibly casting, operating it, feeding it or wearing a matching uniform. No strings, beams, luminous joints, rune scrolls, lenses, smoke chimney, electrical circuit or exposed piston system. Its animation may be enchanted, but the source is not shown or explained.
Two supporting studies: (1) one stone hand/forearm and a plain bronze pin with wear from movement; (2) the faceless head and upper chest, showing sparse tool marks and dignified anonymous design. No cute robot face, eyes made of lamps, stereotypical huge humanoid armor suit, cannon, scenery or miniature city. Neutral presentation, all of the colossal body visible. Aim for ancient craft, imposing calm and genuine weight. Its origin, purpose beyond guarding and operating rules are proposals.
